name: GPU Fleet
author: Travis Meyer (meyert11)
description: Watch the GPUs on this machine and on any number of remote Linux hosts from the bar: utilization, VRAM, RAM used by GPU processes, temperature, power and per-GPU processes. AMD and Intel (kernel sysfs) and NVIDIA (nvidia-smi). Nothing is installed on the remote hosts: a stdlib Python agent is streamed over one SSH session per host.

barWidget.description: Compact utilization + VRAM meters for the GPUs of one host (the tab last picked in the panel); a dot flags hot or offline hosts that aren't shown. Click for a panel with a tab per host.

schema.label: Hot temperature (°C)
schema.description: A GPU's meter turns red at or above this temperature (junction on AMD, core on NVIDIA, CPU package on integrated Intel).
